LanguageData.ResearchAccessed:
Once the data was decrypted, it was easy to read into it. However, all the data seems to be some sort of sensor readings; phsyics equations littering long documents of mathematical terms that dont make sense.

The only content that is understandable is a series of addresses and TLS ids. Only one seems to be active. The computer systems in the bench whir as a triggered script contacts the remaining connection. There's no stopping the outbound message, signaling some unknown recipient of your existence.

There's a noise as a lone transport pod enters the atmosphere nearby. What could it be?
